name: vm-client-mobile-ui
description: Vayalavan — the Android/iOS customer storefront. Feature parity with vm-client-ui.
//workspaces: Deliberately NOT a member of the root npm workspaces, for the same reason vm-supplier-mobile-ui is not: Expo pins its own React (19.1 here) and the three web UIs are on React 18.3, and hoisting both into one root node_modules gives npm a choice it resolves silently and differently on every machine. See README.md 'Why this is not an npm workspace'.
//sdk: Pinned to Expo SDK 54, matched to vm-supplier-mobile-ui. 54 is the newest SDK the App Store and Play Store builds of Expo Go support, so it is the newest that runs on a real iPhone without a paid Apple Developer account. The two mobile apps move together: a developer with one Expo Go install must be able to run both. Change these versions only as a set, via `npx expo install --fix`.

scripts.//port: Metro's default 8081 is vm-profile-api's port, and 8090 is the supplier app's — so this one is 8091 and both phones' apps can run at once. Prefer `make -C infra mobile-client`, which reads MOBILE_CLIENT_METRO_PORT from the root .env; these are the fallback for running from this directory.
